title: Light a shaded material
summary: Some materials respond to light. MeshStandardMaterial needs lighting so its surfaces can show shape and shading.
introduction: Some materials respond to light. MeshStandardMaterial needs lighting so its surfaces can show shape and shading. Your task: Move the directional light to the other side.
learningObjectives: Move the directional light to the other side.
Explain the example for light a shaded material

blocks.text: Some materials respond to light. MeshStandardMaterial needs lighting so its surfaces can show shape and shading.

Use a browser project with the three package installed and a module build tool. Each example creates its own canvas. Run one at a time. These library imports are not supported by this site's plain runner.

blocks.title: Light a shaded material

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `MeshStandardMaterial` responds to scene light. A light source is needed to reveal its shaded surface.
Three.js rotation values use radians. `Math.PI / 2` is a quarter turn.
A perspective camera needs a field of view, aspect ratio, near distance and far distance to describe its view.

blocks.text: The cube faces have different brightness because of the light direction.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A lit material in a scene with no light may appear dark. MeshBasicMaterial does not need light.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Move the directional light to the other side.
